package.name: go2_rmf_adapter
package.description: Open-RMF fleet adapter for go2_omniverse's simulated Go2 fleet. Bridges RMF's traffic negotiation (so multiple robots don't walk into the same ground at the same time) to go2_omniverse's existing waypoint-follow controller via plain geometry_msgs/std_msgs topics, since go2_omniverse's sim process runs on Isaac Sim's bundled ROS 2 Jazzy rclpy (Python-only, no colcon/custom-msg build), while this package runs under a full system ROS 2 Humble install (where RMF itself lives).
